description: Election Commission - R. D. Nimal was selected as the member of the Bingiriya P/S - W. M. Dissanayake was selected as the member of the Mahawa P/S - E. H. M. J. Silva was selected as the member of the Wattala P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including declarations of elected members to fill seats that became vacant due to party membership changes. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
